questions.question: What is the role of the monarch in the British political system?
options: Head of government with real power
questions.explanation: The monarch is the ceremonial head of state, while the Prime Minister is head of government.

questions.question: What is distinctive about the British constitution?
options: There is no single written constitution
It is the world's longest written document
questions.explanation: Britain has no single written constitution — its system rests on statutes, conventions and traditions.

questions.question: What was the result of the 2016 Brexit referendum?
options: Leave won with 51.9% of the vote
questions.explanation: On 23 June 2016, 51.9% voted Leave and 48.1% Remain, with a turnout of 72.2%.

questions.question: Which steps must a British bill pass to become law?
options: House of Commons, House of Lords and Royal Assent
questions.explanation: A bill passes readings in the Commons, then the Lords, and finally receives Royal Assent.

questions.question: How did Scotland and Northern Ireland vote in the Brexit referendum?
options: Both voted Remain, unlike England and Wales
Scotland voted Leave, Northern Ireland Remain
questions.explanation: The geographic divide was striking: England and Wales voted Leave, while Scotland and Northern Ireland voted Remain.
